summary: Staffed two-story lookout in Idaho's Seven Devils, built 1978 to replace a 1924 cabin destroyed by fire in 1958.

access.note: Reached by hiking trail; administered by the Hells Canyon National Recreation Area, Nez Perce National Forest.

events.note: Original log cabin with cupola built on the site.
Original cabin destroyed in a forest fire.
Current flat-top built, 20 years after the fire. NHLR describes a 10' stone base; FireLookout.com describes a two-story concrete base instead — sources disagree on the base material.
Registered with the National Historic Lookout Register.
Kris Anderson recorded as staffing the lookout.

evidence.quote: Heaven's Gate Lookout was so named to counter the fact that it looks over the Seven Devils and the Hells Canyon area
The original 1924 log cabin with cupola was destroyed in a 1958 fire.
It was destroyed in a 1958 forest fire. Apparently 20 years passed before anyone decided to built another lookout here

evidence.supports: current structure is R-6 flattop on 10' stone base
evidence.quote: this R-6 flattop with catwalk on a 10' stone base was constructed

evidence.supports: two-story concrete base, staffed in summer
evidence.quote: The present 2-story concrete base with modified flat cab was built in 1978 and is staffed during the summer.

evidence.supports: administered by Hells Canyon NRA, staffed in recent years
evidence.quote: Heavens Gate Lookout is currently administered by the Hells Canyon National Recreation Area and has been staffed in most recent years.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The research brief flagged possible disagreement on build year, but all three sources checked agree: an original 1924 cabin was destroyed by fire in 1958, and the current structure dates to 1978. No real conflict found.

Fact-check (2026-10-04): NHLR says the 1978 structure sits on a 10' stone base; FireLookout.com calls it a two-story concrete base. These conflict and the original draft silently merged them into one unsourced description. The story and this file now flag the disagreement instead of picking one.

notes_for_editor: Full staffing history is thin in these sources (only one named staffer, Kris Anderson 1983, found clearly). The brief's flagged build-year conflict did not materialize across the three sources checked; could not reach the dead Nez Perce NF link listed in source_pages to check further. No evidence of a rental program; it reads as an actively staffed lookout.
